# Sandoval Service A/C & Refrigeration

> A/C & refrigeration based in San Antonio, Texas. Mario Sandoval fixes home A/C and heating and restaurant refrigeration in North Central San Antonio, and reviewers say he is honest, quick to schedule and catches what other companies missed.

## Services
- A/C repair: Mario diagnoses the real fault, including the ones other companies missed, and fixes it, often the same day.
- A/C replacement & upgrades: When it is time, Mario lays out the options and gives you time to decide, with no push toward the priciest model.
- Heating & furnace repair: Heaters and furnaces brought back to life when the weather turns.
- Coil cleaning: Dirt-packed coils cleaned out so the system can breathe again.
- Commercial refrigeration: Restaurant owners trust Mario with the equipment that keeps their kitchen open.
- Second opinions: Told nothing was wrong, or that you need a whole new system? Mario will take a careful second look.

## About
Sandoval Service A/C & Refrigeration is owned and run by Mario Sandoval, a Texas-licensed A/C contractor (TACLB26835C) based off Burr Oak Drive in North Central San Antonio. Mario has worked on A/C units since he was 18, and he is the one who answers, shows up and does the work. He covers both sides of the trade: central A/C and heating for homes, and walk-in coolers, freezers, reach-ins, prep tables and ice machines for restaurants. Families have used him for years, and one restaurant owner has had him service two locations. Sandoval Service is a Latino-owned local business.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How quickly can Mario get to my house?
  A: Reviewers often get a same-day or next-day visit. One called at 9 in the morning and had a working A/C by 5:30 that evening.
- Q: Do you repair restaurant walk-ins and ice machines?
  A: Yes. Mario services walk-in coolers and freezers, reach-ins, prep tables and ice machines for San Antonio restaurants.
- Q: Another company said nothing was wrong. Can you take a look?
  A: Yes. Several reviewers called Mario after another company missed the problem, and he found it, including a bad breaker.
- Q: Will you push me toward a new system?
  A: No. Customers say Mario lays out every option, gives them time to decide and never pushes the more expensive model.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday 9 AM to noon. Call to ask about urgent A/C or refrigeration problems.
- Q: Is Sandoval Service licensed?
  A: Yes. Mario Sandoval holds Texas A/C contractor licence TACLB26835C.
